verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI for working with an Airwallex account from the command line. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. The evidence does not describe its commands, installation, or any AI-native or agent-oriented features such as structured output or non-interactive auth. missing for 10: details of CLI command coverage and AI/agent-friendly features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Airwallex CLI lets you work with your Airwallex account directly from a command line.
